about.title: Building and running backend systems end to end.
about.p1: I am Mohammed Hakim Awad Ajrah, a Laravel Backend Developer and DevOps Engineer with 2 years of hands-on professional experience building RESTful APIs, managing MySQL databases, deploying on Linux servers, and containerizing applications with Docker.
about.p2: I build and maintain Laravel applications, develop APIs, integrate third-party services, manage MySQL databases, configure Nginx and PHP-FPM, containerize services with Docker and Docker Compose, and deploy through Git and CI/CD workflows to production Linux servers.

philosophy.title: My Philosophy
philosophy.p1: I believe reliable software goes beyond writing code - it means owning the system all the way to production. My approach focuses on clean Laravel architecture backed by servers that are configured, monitored, and troubleshot with care.
philosophy.p2: Whether it's building a REST API, integrating a third-party service, or diagnosing a production outage, I prioritize practical solutions and clear communication between backend and frontend teams.

projects.title: Featured Projects
projects.desc: A showcase of my work building Laravel APIs, deploying production servers, and integrating backend systems with modern frontends.

more.title: Looking for more?
more.desc: I have worked on multiple Laravel-based systems involving REST APIs, e-commerce, restaurant and delivery platforms, multilingual systems, notifications, payment/service integrations, AI APIs, and production server infrastructure. Let's discuss how my experience can help your project.

rushlye.title: Rushlye
rushlye.desc: Laravel-based restaurant and delivery platform. Developed backend APIs, managed production deployment and server configuration, and configured Nginx, PHP-FPM, queues, CORS, DNS, and SSL for rushlye.com and the rushlye.app mobile experience.

azalindustry.title: Azal Industry
azalindustry.desc: Laravel backend development for azalindustry.com, covering APIs, database-driven features, and application business logic, with deployment and troubleshooting handled in production environments.

sahabgold.title: Sahab Gold
sahabgold.desc: Backend development for sahab.gold, including APIs, database-driven functionality, and external service integrations, with ongoing production troubleshooting.

exp1.desc: Developed and maintained Laravel RESTful APIs and backend business logic using PHP, Eloquent ORM, authentication, queues, and notifications. Containerized applications with Docker and Docker Compose, and used Git, GitHub, and Docker Hub for source control and deployment workflows. Deployed applications to Linux production servers, configuring Nginx, PHP-FPM, Supervisor, and PM2, and troubleshooting CORS, DNS, SMTP, database, and server configuration issues.
